valid.rationale: Run 001 (T_eff 9.92) is the best feasible result. It uses loose timing (AREA 3), high density (25), and strong post-GRT repair (RUN_POST_GRT_RESIZER_TIMING=true, RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR=false). It achieves 0 slew/cap violations. Other runs show that enabling both repair steps (e.g., 005, 007) often incurs slew/cap violations or high hold buffer counts. Run 001's setup slack is dominated by I/O ports, which is expected. To improve, we pin the successful configuration of Run 001 to ensure the optimizer explores around this high-quality baseline rather than risking violations with aggressive repair or loose synthesis.
